user.title: Connect ComfoBox gateway
user.description: Enter the gateway address and an API token. You can find the token in the gateway web UI under 'Configuration → API tokens'.

reauth_confirm.title: Enter a new API token
reauth_confirm.description: The previous token is no longer accepted. Please enter a new token from the gateway web UI.

error.cannot_connect: The gateway is not reachable at this address.

abort.already_configured: This gateway is already set up.

init.title: ComfoBox settings
init.description: Values are pushed by the gateway's event stream. This only sets how often the gateway status (connections, write counter) is polled.

legacy_entities.title: Old ComfoBox entities
legacy_entities.description:
After the update there are still {count} entities from an earlier version. They are no longer provided and fill the database with their recordings.

This repair removes them together with their history and long-term statistics. It cannot be undone.

To review them first: Settings → Entities, filter “ComfoBox ELESTA”, the status column shows “unavailable”.

Alternatively use the service `comfobox.cleanup_legacy_entities`.

confirm.title: Remove old ComfoBox entities
confirm.description:
{count} entities will be removed together with their history and long-term statistics.

Entities that still exist are not touched.

Continue?

abort.not_loaded: The ComfoBox integration is not loaded. Please reload the entry under “Devices & Services”.

set_value.name: Set value
set_value.description: Writes a value to a ComfoBox item.

read_all.name: Read all values
read_all.description: Reads all items from the gateway immediately.

cleanup_legacy_entities.name: Clean up old entities
cleanup_legacy_entities.description: Removes entities from earlier versions together with their history and long-term statistics. Returns the number of removed entities.
